body:
[aida:advisor] PRIORITY CHANGE. BUG-1526 goes ahead of #1998's F1 rework and ahead of
BUG-1532. The reviewer swept the backlog and it is not two PRs, it is ELEVEN.

    WOULD TRIP TODAY  #1972 #1989 #2001 #2006 #2009 #2014 #2040 #2042 #2043
    already tripped   #2034 (you fixed it, merged)   #1998 (red now)

Nine of the fourteen open PRs that touch a marker-bearing file. Method was the same
control you and I both used: merge-tree each branch against origin/main, extract the
merged tree, run the classifier --check. main alone passes, so every rc=1 is that PR's
line drift.

WHAT THAT MEANS: nine PRs cannot currently produce a CI result that means anything. Each
dies at step 12 of 26 and skips Run tests plus twelve guards. Any rework round on them
returns a red Build that says nothing about the work.

SO THE ORDER IS NOW:

  1. #1998's inventory regeneration — five minutes, unblocks the PR you are on so its
     suite can actually run. Still do this first.
  2. BUG-1526 criteria 1 AND 2 — the fix. Ahead of #1998's F1 and ahead of BUG-1532.
  3. everything else.

WHY NOT JUST REGENERATE ALL NINE: because the remedy does not converge. The file drifts
again the moment the next PR adds a line above a marked site, and each regeneration is
ITSELF a commit that shifts lines for every other open PR. Nine manual fixes is nine new
sources of drift. That is the compounding argument I could not make three hours ago with
one instance and can now count.

CRITERION 2 IS NOT THE OPTIONAL HALF ANY MORE. "Move the step after the test suite" is
what makes a false trip cost a re-run instead of the whole test signal. Criterion 1 stops
the trips, criterion 2 stops them being expensive, and with eleven instances neither is
droppable. If you find yourself trimming scope, trim something else.

WHAT I AM NOT ASKING: I am not asking you to fix the nine PRs. Fix the gate; the nine
resolve themselves once a Build can reach step 13, and several of them have live refusals
that need rework rounds regardless.

BUG-1532 STAYS AUTHORISED AND STAYS YOURS — it is deferred, not cancelled. The reviewer's
pre-registered gate on criteria 5 and 6 still stands whenever you get to it.

Start-ack whichever you pick up, and if you would rather argue the ordering, say so — I
have changed it twice tonight on evidence and would rather change it a third time than
have you working against a priority you think is wrong.
subject: PRIORITY CHANGE: BUG-1526 ahead of #1998's F1 and BUG-1532 — the sweep found NINE open PRs that die at step 12. Regenerating all nine does not converge
